app.name: The Lending Due Diligence (LDD)
app.title: The Lending Due Diligence (LDD)
app.description: The application supports lending quality assurance and oversight activities across the Business Controls and Risk Management teams, enabling the intake, review, routing, assessment, recommendation, escalation, and resolution of lending transactions.

decisions.name: DecisionOutcomes
decisions.description: Decide on corrective actions or escalations.

decisions.name: TriggerEscalation
decisions.description: Identify high-risk compliance issues requiring senior review.

decisions.name: ValidateResolution
decisions.description: Check completeness of remediation and closure steps.

decisions.name: AssessRoutingCriteria
decisions.description: Determine specialist team (risk or compliance) required for escalation review.

decisions.name: IdentifyGaps
decisions.description: Detect missing or inaccurate information in escalation submission.

decisions.name: EscalateComplexIssues
decisions.description: Route complex or high-risk issues to designated specialists or management for deeper assessment.

decisions.name: RemediationRequired
decisions.description: Recommend corrective actions for identified issues.

decisions.name: FlagForEscalation
decisions.description: Identify cases needing escalation to senior risk or compliance officers.

decisions.name: IdentifyRiskSignals
decisions.description: Flag suspicious indicators such as high-risk criteria, unusual transaction patterns, or third-party alerts.

decisions.name: OutcomeDecision
decisions.description: Record resolution status and update transaction history in compliance system.
